about: Retry list for Resources page links that failed an automated check, plus uncrewed-platform candidates that were unreachable when evaluated. This file is not rendered on the site. Restore a removed entry verbatim from title, url, group, section, description, and region.
notes: Rechecked from the Linux box and from the laptop (Aurora) on 2026-11-26. No listed Resources links were removed: ERVO and the Canadian Coast Guard page look dead to curl/PowerShell but load in a browser. The site footer checked-live date was left at 2026-11-19 because several remaining links still fail automated checks from one or both networks.

entries.title: European Research Vessel Operators (ERVO)
entries.description: European research-vessel operators' group, including a members list (historically at /np4/members/)

failures.detail: https://www.ervo-group.eu/ returned HTTP 302 Location: http://www.ervo-group.eu/np4/home; following that HTTP URL returned HTTP 500.

Same result: listed URL followed the HTTP redirect and returned HTTP 500 in 2.0s. Direct GET of https://www.ervo-group.eu/np4/home returned HTTP 200. Direct GET of https://www.ervo-group.eu/np4/members/ returned HTTP 200.

Failed on the listed URL: PowerShell refused to follow the insecure HTTP redirect ("Operation is not valid due to the current state of the object" / cannot follow an insecure redirection). https://www.ervo-group.eu/np4/home and https://www.ervo-group.eu/np4/members/ both returned HTTP 200. http://www.ervo-group.eu/np4/home also returned 200 after upgrading to HTTPS.
Listed URL returned HTTP 302 and was not followed.

successes.detail: Loaded the listed URL; page title was "ERVO GROUP // Home" (about 12 KB of HTML).

entries.notes: Not removed. The listed homepage URL redirects to an HTTP path that some automated clients follow and then see a 500, or refuse to follow. A browser and the HTTPS paths /np4/home and /np4/members/ work. A later edit could point the listing at https://www.ervo-group.eu/np4/home if the insecure redirect persists.
